description: The Twin Spirit Loft Bed Frame is a Super Strong Space Saver; great for apartments, college dorms, bedrooms or camps. The Twin Spirit Loft Bed can help you make over any bedroom with space-saving efficiency. This loft is built with Premium Solid Southern Yellow Pine, has removable guard rails (all 4 sides) for easy top bunk access, and comes ready to assemble. End Panels are preassembled and provide a built-in ladder (although separate ladders are available). Adjustable Top Bed Rail lets you choose between 52 or 54.5 Inch Clearance above the floor. 100% Clean Natural Wood. Eco-friendly and Comes with a 10-Year Warranty - Proudly Made in the U.S.A. Dimensions: 67.5"H x 41.5"D x 78"L. You are buying ONLY the Twin Spirit Loft Bed Frame.
